title.zh: 泰尔哈德猴属来源限定证据

description.en: Open the Explorer at Teilhardina to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开泰尔哈德猴属，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

title.zh: 泰尔哈德猴属出现窗口

description.en: Open a source-bounded Teilhardina time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的泰尔哈德猴属时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Compare Teilhardina and Morotopithecus through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较泰尔哈德猴属与莫罗托古猿属；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open the map within the late Puercan Garbani Channel window to inspect sampled context for UCMP 197509, UCMP 197517 and related Purgatorius-attributed tarsals.
description.zh: 在晚Puercan期Garbani Channel窗口内打开地图，检查UCMP 197509、UCMP 197517及相关归入Purgatorius的跗骨的采样背景。

limitations: The 65.2–64.4 Ma route is the bounded Garbani Channel fauna in the Tullock Member of the Fort Union Formation, Montana, not a direct date on an associated skeleton. The tarsals are attributed to Purgatorius by comparative analysis (Chester et al. 2015, pp. 1487–1492, Figs. 1–3, SI Appendix Figs. S1–S5 and Tables S1–S3); arboreal euarchontan morphology is an interpretation, not observed crown-Primate membership. The sparse sample and map markers do not establish a global FAD/LAD, complete distribution, direct ancestor or exact specimen-marker co-location.

description.en: Open the map at the approximately 47.5 Ma Messel Pit horizon to inspect sampled context for the Darwinius part-and-counterpart holotype, PMO 214.214 and WDC-MG-210.
description.zh: 在约4750万年前的Messel坑层位打开地图，检查Darwinius拼合正模PMO 214.214与WDC-MG-210的采样背景。

limitations: The 47.5 Ma point is the Messel Pit, Hesse, Germany, horizon for one part-and-counterpart holotype (Franzen et al. 2009, e5723, Figs. 1–16, Tables 1–4), not a global adapiform or primate first appearance. Preserved anatomy is direct evidence, while sex, life history, ecology and haplorhine/crown placement are interpretations; the map does not establish global FAD/LAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry or exact holotype-marker co-location.

description.en: Open the map within the 29–28 Ma biochronological window to inspect sampled context for SGS-UM 2009-002 from Harrat Al Ujayfa, western Saudi Arabia.
description.zh: 在2900万至2800万年前的生物年代窗口内打开地图，检查来自沙特阿拉伯西部Harrat Al Ujayfa的SGS-UM 2009-002采样背景。

limitations: The age is a biochronological Middle Shumaysi Formation interval, not a direct specimen date or a crown-catarrhine divergence time (Zalmout et al. 2010, pp. 360–365, Figs. 1–4, Methods). The 36-character, 19-taxon matrix places this specimen on a catarrhine stem in the cited analysis, not as a crown catarrhine or direct ancestor; the bounded occurrence and map markers do not establish global FAD/LAD, complete distribution or exact specimen-marker co-location.

description.en: Open the map within the Thanetian Adrar Mgorn 1 interval to inspect sampled context for holotype THR 141 and the associated isolated-tooth hypodigm from Morocco.
description.zh: 在摩洛哥Adrar Mgorn 1的坦尼特期区间内打开地图，检查正模THR 141及相关孤立牙齿标本组的采样背景。

limitations: The approximately 59.2–56 Ma route follows the Adrar Mgorn 1, Jbel Guersif Formation, Ouarzazate Basin context (Sige et al. 1990, pp. 31–56, Plate 1), not a direct radiometric date on THR 141. Tooth-locus assignments and the hypodigm are disputed, and the original omomyid or near/outside-crown-Primate placement is a hypothesis; the isolated-tooth sample and map markers do not establish global FAD/LAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry or exact specimen-marker co-location.
